info.title: Weibo Group AI API
info.description: Versioned API for querying archived Weibo group messages, users, groups and analytics, plus background archive exports, existing keyword/sender monitors, owned collection tasks and notification diagnostics, and sending text and image messages to owned groups. Use stable operationId values as AI tool names or expose them through the bundled MCP stdio adapter. Send API tokens as Bearer credentials; message-send operations require the api:write token scope.

aiBearer.description: API token created by POST /api/admin/api-tokens. The raw value is shown once.

get.summary: List groups with message coverage and crawl gap status
get.description: Start group discovery here: use q to find a group by name across all owned accounts in one request; each result includes accountId/groupId, so listAccounts is not required first. Use hasOpenGap/openGapCount before completeness-sensitive summaries.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: Optional account scope; omit it to list groups for every account.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Literal case-insensitive group-name substring; use this to resolve a group named by the user.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum groups in this page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque nextCursor returned by listGroups; pass it back only to listGroups with the same accountId and q filters. Omit it on the first page; null means pagination is complete.

200.description: Successful list groups with message coverage and crawl gap status response.

messageCount.description: Number of messages currently archived for this group; it may be incomplete when hasOpenGap is true.

firstMessageTime.description: Earliest archived message time as Unix seconds, or null when no timed message is stored; not proof of the upstream history boundary.

lastMessageTime.description: Latest archived message time as Unix seconds, or null when no timed message is stored; not proof that newer upstream history is absent.

lastPollAt.description: Most recent successful poll time as Unix seconds, or null.

gapFilledAt.description: Most recent recorded gap-fill time as Unix seconds, or null.

active.description: Whether this tracked group has polled within the configured active window.

openGapCount.description: Number of known unfilled crawl gaps. A positive value means archived messages may be incomplete.

hasOpenGap.description: True when openGapCount is positive; do not claim archive completeness while true.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next listGroups page; null means pagination is complete.

get.summary: List/search messages with cursor pagination
get.description: Search archived messages after discovering accountId/groupId with listAccounts/listGroups. Check hasOpenGap before completeness-sensitive summaries. Prefer raw=0 and chronological time sorting. REST callers reuse identical filters, searchMode, sort and order with nextCursor until null when full pagination is needed; the stdio MCP adapter automatically aggregates chronological raw=0 pages up to its configured message/response budget and reports pagination.complete/truncated. Dates use the configured application timezone. semantic/hybrid first pages explicitly report whether vector search applied or fell back to lexical ranking and whether the bounded candidate window was truncated; candidate results are discovery evidence, not proof of full archive coverage.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: Account identifier returned by listAccounts.

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: Account-scoped group identifier returned by listGroups; always pair it with accountId.

parameters.name: senderUid
parameters.description: Weibo user identifier returned in message senderUid or a user/member response.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Non-blank expression search over content and sender. Supports quoted phrases with \" escapes, AND/OR/NOT (or &&/||/!), parentheses, implicit AND, from:<sender> (for example from:user && "keyword"), and msgtype:<img|video|file|audio|link|emoticon|hongbao|system|recall|text>. Unknown msgtype values are invalid. NOT has highest precedence, then AND, then OR.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive valid calendar day in the configured application timezone (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive valid calendar day in the configured application timezone (YYYY-MM-DD); must not precede from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum messages in this page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque nextCursor returned by searchMessages; pass it back only to searchMessages with identical filters, searchMode, sort, and order. Omit it on the first page; null means pagination is complete.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Message order; desc returns newest first. sort=relevance requires order=desc.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: time preserves chronological order; relevance requires q and ranks matches using searchMode.

parameters.name: searchMode
parameters.description: Relevance engine. semantic/hybrid require q with sort=relevance; first-page provider/index failures return an explicit lexical fallback.

parameters.name: raw
parameters.description: String flag, not a boolean: use "0" by default or "1" to include rawJson. raw=1 can substantially increase response size.

200.description: Successful list/search messages with cursor pagination response.

messageTime.description: Message time as a Unix timestamp in seconds; null means the source had no usable time.

messageType.description: Weibo envelope code. Known values: 1=legacy text, 321=chat, 322=system notice, 344=recall; unknown codes are preserved.

subType.description: Weibo subtype code. Known values: 101=platform safety/fraud reminder (also used by recall placeholders); unknown codes are preserved.

mediaType.description: Weibo media code. Known values: 0=text, 1=image, 4=audio, 5=file, 9=emoticon card, 10=video, 11=link, 13=red envelope, 14=Weibo status, 15=animated emoji. Location, card, and forward payloads are inferred from their fields; unknown codes are preserved.

score.description: Applied relevance score; compare scores only within the same query and mode.

lexicalScore.description: Raw lexical score when the row was present in the lexical candidate set.

semanticScore.description: Cosine similarity when the row was present in the semantic candidate set.

snippet.description: Bounded plain-text content excerpt. It never contains injected HTML markup.

highlights.description: Character offsets into the original named message field.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next searchMessages page; null means pagination is complete.

complete.description: True only when this response covers every matching message; a false value requires continuing nextCursor.

pagesFetched.description: Number of chronological REST pages fetched while creating this response; a bounded partial result may have fetched one page that could not be included.

returnedMessageCount.description: Number of message records included in this response.

truncated.description: True when a bounded MCP aggregation stopped before nextCursor became null or an upstream page reported truncation.

requestedMode.description: Search mode requested by the caller.

appliedMode.description: Search mode actually used after any explicit fallback.

semanticApplied.description: True only when semantic scoring contributed to this page.

fallbackReason.description: Why the request fell back from semantic/hybrid ranking; null means no fallback was needed.

candidateSetTruncated.description: True when semantic or hybrid ranking was limited to a bounded candidate window; false does not prove archive completeness when indexing has gaps.

search.description: Applied ranking and fallback metadata; null when no text/relevance search was requested.

post.description: Reuse the background export queue to generate CSV, XLSX or JSON from an owned account/group and optional senderUid/dates/keywords. Requires api:write. get.summary: Inspect owned notification hit and delivery totals
get.description: Same rule/target statistics as the management UI, scoped to the token owner. Time filters apply to hit/job creation times, not original message time or failure time. Default last 24 hours, at most 31 days. hitCount is stored rule/message/keyword rows, not unique messages; sentCount/pushCount are notification jobs and successRate is null with no jobs. Queued/in-progress jobs can lower the observed ratio. No job is not proof of no match: quiet hours, throttles and disabled destinations can suppress enqueueing. Channels are capped at 100; narrow by platform/channelId if truncated.

parameters.description: Inclusive epoch seconds; defaults to current server time.

get.summary: Inspect recent owned notification delivery outcomes
get.description: Time filters apply to job creation time, not failure time. Default last 24 hours, maximum 31 days, scoped by owner and optional platform/channelId/status. Returns fixed failure categories inferred from server-side errors, never original errors, claims, payloads or credentials. A null category is unknown, not proof of health; a category is a diagnostic hint, not a confirmed root cause. Use monitor-rule hits/routes to distinguish matching, suppression and actual delivery. Paginate explicitly.
